hook: This robot vacuum mop was $1,300. Now it's $299.

scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of a mop bucket sitting in a kitchen corner, slightly dusty, next to a price tag graphic showing $1,300 with a red strikethrough
scenes.voiceover: Two years ago, a self-washing robot mop cost more than my first car payment.

scenes.visual_prompt: Same kitchen, robot vacuum dock with price tag now reading $299, Black Friday sale banner subtle in background
scenes.voiceover: This Black Friday, the same self-cleaning dock mechanism is clustering around $299.

scenes.visual_prompt: Macro shot of robot vacuum dock washing mop pads with visible hot water and rollers, steam rising
scenes.on_screen_text: Washes its own mop pads in hot water
scenes.voiceover: The dock washes the mop pads in hot water and wrings them with rollers, so you're not rinsing anything in your sink.

scenes.visual_prompt: Dustbin compartment opening to show a sealed bag, calendar graphic flipping through 4-7 weeks
scenes.voiceover: The dustbin auto-empties into a bag rated for four to seven weeks, depending on your home and your pets.

scenes.visual_prompt: Split screen: robot gliding over open hardwood floor on one side, mop bucket shoved into a closet corner on the other
scenes.voiceover: It doesn't replace a mop entirely. Stairs, corners, the strip behind your toilet — that's still manual.

scenes.visual_prompt: Reviewer hand pointing at phone screen showing a 4.6-star rating with 195,567 reviews on a backup mop
scenes.voiceover: I'm keeping a $35 spin mop in the closet for exactly those spots.

scenes.visual_prompt: Final shot: robot vacuum parked at its dock, clean kitchen floor reflecting light, text overlay with link icon
scenes.on_screen_text: Full breakdown + specs on the blog
scenes.voiceover: I broke down every spec and every reviewer complaint on the blog — link's in my bio.

caption: A dock that washes and dries its own mop pads used to cost $900-$1,300. This Black Friday it's showing up at $299, and I went through the specs, the pricing history, and what reviewers with pets actually report before deciding if it's a real deal or a sticker reset. Full writeup linked in bio.
